name: pancreator-reminder-relay
description: Start the workspace reminder relay with VS Code and stop it when its last window closes.

pancreator.reminderRelay.enabled.description: Automatically start the reminder relay in trusted Pancreator workspaces.

pancreator.reminderRelay.port.description: Stable relay port for this workspace. Choose distinct ports for different workspaces; 0 selects an available port.

pancreator.reminderRelay.harnessPath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative harness path for a detached install. Empty detects a source checkout or .pancreator.
